notes.title: Patch update 1.0
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 

We've made some small bug fixes that we recently pushed out and wanted to give our players a quick overview of what those updates are. Big thank you to our [url=https://discord.com/invite/cg75GduRAG]Discord[/url] community for pointing them out and helping us make sure they get resolved. 

[b][u]Bug Fixes:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Upon completing all of the other achievements, the "Profane" achievement allowing you to officially 100% the game wasn't activating. This should be fixed now allowing for 100% completion! 
[*] The Retry blessing in challenge mode had decided you weren't worthy of another try. We've fixed this and the retry blessing should now allow you to give it another go. 
[*] Mobus decided he had regenerative abilities and once you defeated his first phase, parts of his middle segments would come back to life when you had moved on to attacking just his tail. We worked on Mobus and he will no longer do this.
[*] The "Radiant Flux" active camera was doing some weird shifting. We've also fixed this so there should be no more shifty things. 
[/list]

notes.title: Launch Day Updates
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Firstly, thank you all so much for your support throughout the journey of this game. It's been a bumpy ride but we finally made it to launch! 

Now that we've launched, we've made a couple updates we want everyone to be aware of:
[list]
[*] Mobus had decided that you were too strong to battle, so after phase 2, he would just disappear, making him unbeatable. We've got him working again and ready to take you on for the whole fight. 
[*] We had a player reach out to use about being a disabled gamer and requested a way to move the cursor inside and outside of the game window. We added this to the game and by pressing M on the keyboard, you unlock the "SashaZenko mode." In this mode you can see the cursor all of the time. If you want to turn it back off, just hit M again.
[*] Ultrawide screen (21:9) support - Ultrawide screens for ultrawide bosses
[*] In some localizations, we noticed some loading screen texts were getting cut off by the screen. Now you should be able to read all of the loading screen texts in whatever localization you're playing in. 
[*] Some achievements weren't unlocking upon completion. Now all achievements should be achievable!
[/list]

Again thank you for the support. If you want to talk with the community or report bugs a bit faster, definitely join our [url=https://discord.gg/cg75GduRAG]Discord[/url]!

notes.title: Hotfix - Mobus (4th Boss)
notes.content:
We found a bug where Mobus (the 4th boss) doesn't appear in the second phase, but it is now fixed!

Please update the game and try to beat it!

notes.title: Steam Game Festival Demo Challenges
notes.content:
[b]The Steam Game Festival is finally here meaning so is our demo![/b]  
To celebrate, we’ve got some challenges for you! Winners of each challenge, or tribe for “Best Time” will receive a key to the game upon release! 

[b]No Hit[/b] - defeat Drakhul and take no damage during the fight.
[b]No Abilities[/b] - defeat Drakhul without using any abilities. 
[b]Best Time[/b] - defeat Drakhul as quick as you can. The fastest times from each tribe for this one will win. Utilize your tribe to help each other get the fastest run!

[u][b]Rules: [/b][/u]
-For the “No Hit” and “No Abilities” challenges, you must upload a video to [url=https://discord.com/invite/cg75GduRAG]Discord[/url] noting which challenge you attempted and completed. In the event more than one person is able to complete either of these challenges, the person with the fastest time will be the winner. 
-For the “Best Time” challenge, screenshots must also be uploaded to [url=https://discord.com/invite/cg75GduRAG]Discord[/url] noting that you think you have the best time. 
-Multiple entries are allowed. If you beat your time on a particular challenge and want to resubmit, you can, just please note that it is your better time when posting. 
-Easy mode can NOT be enabled for your entry to count. challenges must be completed in normal mode. 
-You can submit entries in all 3 challenges. If 1 person happens to win more than one challenge (or for their respective tribe + another challenge), they will select which challenge they would like to be declared official winner of, and then prizes will then be awarded to the 2nd place finishers for the other challenges. 
-Event runs from Feb 3rd 2 pm EST - Feb 9th at 11:59 pm EST. Winners will be announced Feb 10th at 12 pm EST. Prizes will then be Dm’ed from our mod on Discord

notes.title: Steam Game Festival 2021: Godstrike hands-on preview
notes.content:
If the four words "bullet-hell boss rush" pique your interest, Godstrike will absolutely make you stand at attention. Firmly entrenching itself into a familiar arcade-like sized hole and refusing to come out, this new experience from OverPowered Team and Freedom! Games is fun, fast, and brutal. Time is now your most important resource, acting as your health in game and as your currency for new spells.

The twin-stick controls need little introduction, however, a short tutorial is included for any run-and-gun novices. With no time to waste, this game makes a quick and smooth first impression. Showcasing a simple yet pleasing art style accompanied by somber orchestration, Godstrike is a treat to behold. The basic bullet-dodging shoot-'em-up formula is enhanced with customizable loadouts, giving players choice over active and passive spells, greatly influencing playstyles and synergies. A roguelite-style mode is planned for players that need a little uncertainty in their hectic Godstriking. Online leaderboards to keep track of friends' scores and even Twitch integration for live viewer interaction round out the community features. These really help in making arcade-style speedrun-friendly games more appealing to everyone.

The demo provides a calm, serene starting hub encased in the cosmos, allowing players to familiarize themselves with four active and four passive spells for use. Over 40 spells total will be featured in the final game, but this sampling did well at whetting the appetite. A spread shot, beam weapon, teleporting dash, and projectile eliminating blast offered a nice mix of offensive and defensive options. The passive spells were a little more basic, with a speed and soul boost to aid in picking up much needed souls for your active spells. The remaining two passives protect the player from enemy fire, but only in a limited capacity. From here, it's a short step until you are teleported to the boss.

Being a "boss rush" style game, these encounters make up the bulk of the gameplay and have multiple attack patterns and phases. The Godstrike demo kicks the action up to an immediate 11 and never lets up. Faced with an enormous beating heart encased in ribs, this boss named Drakhul makes short work of teaching you just how hellish this game will be. Bullet patterns start pulsating from the oversized heart in rhythmic waves with increasing tempo almost immediately. Dispatching the organ will reveal a gigantic skull with extra spiked mandibles. Drakhul's second phase is frantic and overwhelming, but repeated play and smart spell use can see you through quickly to the final phase. With a gigantic pool of lava now in the playfield, space is tight to maneuver around the attacks of this demonic cranium.

I finally succeeded in vanquishing Drakhul after what felt like a hundred tries, and it left me wanting to try a hundred more on the next boss. Coming in Spring 2021, the wait for more Godstrike won't be long. If you love twin-stick shooters, bullet-hell style arcade games, or brutal roguelite boss rushes, Godstrike definitely belongs on your Steam wishlist.

This preview is based on an early Steam demo build provided by the publisher. The Godstrike demo will be available as part of the Steam Game Festival 2021 and will launch on Steam in Spring 2021.
